title: Fadnavis defends UCC decision, accuses Opposition of provoking street protests

ai.summary: Maharashtra Chief Minister Fadnavis defended his government's UCC draft, claiming it is constitutionally mandated and accusing the Opposition of provoking street protests to undermine institutions.

facts.claim: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis defended his government’s decision to draft a Uniform Civil Code (UCC)
facts.quote: Mumbai, Nov 10: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis on Tuesday defended his government’s decision to draft a Uniform Civil Code (UCC)

facts.claim: Fadnavis said the UCC is rooted in the Directive Principles of State Policy
facts.quote: Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar’s Constitution has given us fundamental rights and incorporated Directive Principles of State Policy. One of these directives says every state should bring a Uniform Civil Code.

facts.claim: Fadnavis accused the Opposition of provoking street protests
facts.quote: Fadnavis claimed the Opposition was following a strategy of questioning and demonising every institution, including the Supreme Court, Election Commission, Parliament, CAG and RBI, to create a conspiracy narrative and undermine public faith in them.

ai.background_note: Maharashtra government is drafting a Uniform Civil Code (UCC) which is a constitutional directive requiring states to implement a uniform set of civil laws for all citizens, but the opposition claims it is provoking protests.
